```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(cmocean)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggtext)

theme_set(theme_bw() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))

# dput(palette.colors(palette = "Okabe-Ito"))
colors <- c('Baseline'="#E69F00",'Case counts'="#D55E00",'Tree'="#0072B2",'Combined'="#009E73")

params <- read_csv('../full_output/parameters/test_design.csv') %>% 
  select(param_id, R0_true=R0, D_true=recovery_time) %>% 
  mutate(R0_level = cut(
      R0_true,
      breaks = quantile(R0_true, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3)),
      labels = str_to_sentence(c("low", "middle", "high")),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    D_level = cut(
      D_true,
      breaks = quantile(D_true, probs = seq(0, 1, 1/3)),
      labels = str_to_sentence(c("short", "medium", "long")),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
         R0_level = factor(paste(R0_level, 'R0'), levels = paste(str_to_sentence(c("low", "middle", "high")), 'R0')),
         D_level = factor(paste(D_level, 'D'), levels = paste(str_to_sentence(c("short", "medium", "long")),'D')))

nsbi_evaluation <- lapply(list.files('../full_output/inference', recursive = TRUE, pattern = 'hpd_confidence_regions.csv', full.names = TRUE), function(x) 
  read_csv(x) %>% mutate(type = gsub('../full_output/inference/|_model|_confidence_regions.csv', '', x))) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(type = gsub('/.*', '', type))


baseline_evaluation <- read_csv('../full_output/sir_mle/results.csv') %>% 
  mutate(type = 'baseline')

evaluation <- nsbi_evaluation %>% 
  mutate(param_id = as.numeric(gsub('p', '', param_id))) %>%
  bind_rows(baseline_evaluation) %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(type == 'tsfeatures' ~ 'Case counts',
                          type == 'tsfeatures_treefeatures' ~ 'Combined',
                          type == 'baseline' ~ 'Baseline',
                          type == 'treefeatures' ~ 'Tree',
                          TRUE ~ str_to_sentence(type)),
                          type = factor(type, levels = rev(c('Baseline', 'Case counts', 'Tree', 'Combined')))) %>% 
  left_join(params)

param_scan <- lapply(list.files('../full_output/param_scan_sub', full.names = TRUE), function(x){
  read_csv(x) %>% mutate(type = gsub('../full_output/param_scan_sub/|_model.*', '', x))
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% 
  group_by(sim_id, type) %>% 
  mutate(r = predicted_probability/(1-predicted_probability),
         r = r/sum(r)) %>% 
  inner_join(params) %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(type == 'tsfeatures' ~ 'Case counts',
                          type == 'tsfeatures_treefeatures' ~ 'Combined',
                          type == 'baseline' ~ 'Baseline',
                          type == 'treefeatures' ~ 'Tree',
                          TRUE ~ str_to_sentence(type)),
                          type = factor(type, levels = (c('Baseline', 'Case counts', 'Tree', 'Combined'))))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
bayes_evaluation <- read_csv('../full_output/sir_bayes/results.csv') %>% 
  mutate(type = 'baseline')

bayes_evaluation %>% 
  group_by(converged) %>% 
  tally()

bind_rows(baseline_evaluation %>% mutate(method = 'mle'),
          bayes_evaluation %>% mutate(method = 'bayes')) %>% 
  filter(converged) %>%
  group_by(sim_id) %>% filter(n() == 2) %>% 
  group_by(method) %>% 
  summarize(R0_mae = mean(R0_abs_error),
            D_mae = mean(D_abs_error),
            R0_coverage = mean(R0_coverage),
            D_coverage = mean(D_coverage),
            R0_interval_width_mean = mean(R0_interval_width),
            D_interval_width_mean = mean(D_interval_width),
            R0_interval_score_mean = mean(R0_interval_score),
            D_interval_score_mean = mean(D_interval_score)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!method) %>% 
  mutate(param = gsub('_.*', '', name),
         metric = gsub('R0_|D_', '', name)) %>% 
  select(-name) %>% 
  arrange(param, method) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(param, method), values_from = value) 
```

## Evaluation metrics

```{r evaluation, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# Build the combined dataset
plot_data <- evaluation %>%
  select(type, R0_error, D_error) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(R0_error, D_error)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(type, name, value)

# Compute MAE per type/name group
mae_labels <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(type, name) %>%
  summarise(mae = mean(abs(value), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Join MAE back and create a combined label for the y-axis
err_plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  left_join(mae_labels, by = c("type", "name")) %>%
  mutate(name = case_when(name == 'R0_error' ~ 'R0',
                          name == 'D_error' ~ 'D')) %>% 
  mutate(type_label = paste0(type, "\nMAE = ", round(mae, 2))) %>% 
  arrange(type)


ggarrange(
  err_plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_inorder(type_label), x = abs(value), fill = type)) +
  facet_grid(name ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = TRUE) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(x = 'Absolute error', y = 'Model type') +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
          legend.position = 'none'),
  
evaluation %>% 
  select(type, R0_interval_width, D_interval_width) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!type) %>% 
  mutate(name = case_when(name == 'R0_interval_width' ~ 'R0',
                          name == 'D_interval_width' ~ 'D')) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = type, x = value, fill = type)) +
  facet_grid(name~.) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(x = '95% interval width', y = '') +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
          legend.position = 'none'),

evaluation %>% 
  select(type, R0_coverage, D_coverage) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!type) %>% 
  mutate(name = case_when(name == 'R0_coverage' ~ 'R0',
                          name == 'D_coverage' ~ 'D')) %>% 
  group_by(type, name, value) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  group_by(type,  name) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n/sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(value) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = prop, y = type, fill = type)) +
  facet_grid(name~.) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, col = 'black') +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.95, linetype = 'dotted') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(x = '95% empirical coverage', y = '') +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
          legend.position = 'none'),

evaluation %>% 
  select(type, R0_interval_score, D_interval_score) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!type) %>% 
  mutate(name = case_when(name == 'R0_interval_score' ~ 'R<sub>0</sub>',
```

```{r pairwise_evaluation}
eval_wide <- evaluation %>%
  select(sim_id, type, R0_error, D_error) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(R0_error, D_error)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(value)) 

# Define the metric columns we want to compare
metric_cols <- c("Tree", "Case counts", "Combined", "Baseline")

# Generate all unique pairs of these columns
pairs <- combn(metric_cols, 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Compute the difference for each pair, and stack into one long data frame
diff_df <- map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
  eval_wide %>%
    transmute(
      sim_id,
      name,
      comparison = paste0(p[1], " - ", p[2]),
      diff = abs(.data[[p[1]]]) - abs(.data[[p[2]]])
    )
})

# Compute medians per name x comparison group
median_df <- diff_df %>%
  group_by(name, comparison) %>%
  summarise(median_diff = median(diff, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Quantile of 0 within each group's distribution (i.e., % of values <= 0)
quantile_df <- diff_df %>%
  group_by(name, comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_below_zero = mean(diff <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(percent(pct_below_zero, accuracy = 1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = diff)) +
  facet_grid(comparison ~ name, scales = "free") +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", binwidth = 0.1) +
  geom_text(
    data = quantile_df,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = Inf,
      label = label,
      vjust = 1.5 
    ),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3.2,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', col = 'red') +
  labs(
    x = "Difference",
    y = "Count",
  ) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
```





## Replicate analysis


```{r estimate_variance, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
evaluation %>% 
  select(param_id, replicate, R0_true, D_true, type, R0_point_estimate, D_point_estimate) %>% 
  pivot_longer(ends_with('estimate')) %>% 
  group_by(type, name, param_id, R0_true, D_true) %>%
  summarize(var = var(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(var = ifelse(var == 0, 0.01, var),
         name = paste(gsub('_point_estimate', '', name), 'estimate'),
         name = gsub('R0', 'R<sub>0</sub>', name),
         type = factor(type, levels = rev(levels(type)))
         ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = R0_true, y = D_true, col = var)) +
  facet_grid(name~type) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + 
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_viridis_c(trans = 'log10') +
  labs(col = 'Within-replicate\npoint estimate\nvariance', x = 'True R<sub>0</sub>', y = 'True D') +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_markdown(),
        axis.title.x = element_markdown())
```


## Evaluation by R0 and D

```{r evaluation_parameters, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
ggarrange(evaluation %>% 
  mutate(param = 'D') %>% 
    select(type, param, sim_id, true_value=D_level, diff=D_abs_error, width=D_interval_width, interval_score=D_interval_score) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(diff, width, interval_score)) %>% 
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = (c('Baseline', 'Case counts', 'Tree', 'Combined'))),
         name = case_when(name == 'diff' ~ 'Absolute error',
                          name == 'width' ~ '95% interval width',
                          name == 'interval_score' ~ 'Interval score',
                          name == 'crps' ~ 'CRPS'),
         name = factor(name, levels = c('Absolute error', '95% interval width', 'Interval score', 'CRPS'))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = true_value, x = value, col = type, fill = type)) +
  facet_grid(~name, scales = 'free') +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(scale = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(x = 'Evaluation metric', y = 'True D tercile', col = 'Model type', fill = 'Model type') +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          strip.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)),
```

## Posterior visualization


```{r posterior, fig.width=10, fig.height=3.5}
min_val  <- log10(min(param_scan$r))
midpoint_val <- log10(1/(100*100)) # this depends on the grid size
max_val <- log10(max(param_scan$r))

param_scan %>% 
  filter(param_id %in% c(334, 461, 540, 822, 1335, 1948, 2072, 3384, 4224)) %>% 
  mutate(id = paste0('R<sub>0</sub> = ', round(R0_true, 2), '<br>D = ', round(D_true, 1))) %>% 
  arrange(R0_level, D_level) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = R0, y = recovery_time, fill = r)) +
    facet_grid(type~fct_inorder(id)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_point(aes(x = R0_true, y = D_true), shape = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = cmocean("balance", start = 0.1, end = 0.9)(100),
    limits = c(min_val, max_val),
    values = rescale((c(min_val, midpoint_val, max_val))),
    trans = 'log10', 
  ) +
  labs(fill = 'Posterior\nprobability', y = 'D', x = 'R<sub>0</sub>') +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_markdown(),
        strip.text.x = element_markdown())
```
